generation-flatten.geometry: Shared original PIPER rigid visual prototypes with independent true FK poses; main cloth Catmull-Clark, all other cloth uses original physical triangles without subdivision.
generation-flatten.scope: Synchronized replay of independently generated successful trajectories. Every source begins at s0, reaches its verified successful released terminal state, and holds that exact terminal state after completion. This is recorded replay at 4× speed, not measured live parallel generation throughput.
generation-flatten.validation: 425 frames at 25fps, full H.264 decode and exact per-source sampling indices verified. Repeated terminal states occur only after completion, with at least two seconds of final completed-state display.
